purpose: Govern GSSC quotation geometry, typography, page architecture, assets, signatures, commercial logic, and print workflow.
human_note: A GSSC quotation is an editorial commercial document, not a spreadsheet-style price list.

typography.unit_rule: px only; never convert quotation typography to pt

pages.page_1: Editorial cover: kicker, title, dek, prep line, lede, body, pull quote, closing.
pages.page_2: Program cards or scope, reference row and total row.
pages.page_3: Commercial terms, acceptance gate and canonical signature.

stripe_rule: Preserve the exact source-master implementation and measured top/bottom bounds. Never assume a full-page stripe.

assets.delivery: Preserve and embed source assets; self-contained HTML preferred.
assets.processing: True aspect ratio; content-aware crop; LANCZOS only when transformation is explicitly required; preserve transparency.

signature.canonical: Ronnie S. del Castillo · Chief Executive Officer · GSSC Integrated Corporation
signature.canonical_president_of_record: Duke Y. Demayo · President · Principal · Chief Operating Officer · GSSC Integrated Corporation
signature.default_client_facing_signatory: Ronnie S. del Castillo, Chief Executive Officer
signature.style: Gold accent rule above the name; signatory name in gold; title line in muted italic beneath. Integrated logo lockup sits above the name, signatory block at the bottom of the closing page.

commercial.validity_default: 30 calendar days unless the quotation states otherwise.
commercial.warranty_default: 18-month workmanship warranty for fabrication-heavy programs; otherwise use the program-specific authoritative term.
commercial.governing_law: Republic of the Philippines; venue Iloilo City.

acceptance_gate.style: Light confidentiality; no unnecessary legal clutter.

program_cards.firewall: No itemized cost, supplier attribution, or margin wording.
program_cards.tier_comparison_rule: Use the registered tier_comparison component (03_brand.component_registry) when a requirement is genuinely modular. Never manufacture tiers to create the appearance of choice: a fabricated Essential tier that no client would accept is a discount anchor, not an option, and it invites the client to buy it.

print_workflow: Chrome or Edge → Ctrl+P → A4 portrait → Margins None → Background graphics ON → 100% scale → Save as PDF.
